answer: Close the haven to registration: each identity anchors to one verified legal entity, checked by two registrars who each stake 50 units and forfeit it for a false check. The identity locks 70 units until its first audit ends. One fake costs one entity plus 70 units; ten fakes need ten entities and 700 units, and each extra entity adds paperwork and a new registrar pair at risk, so effort grows faster than the count. A reused anchor cancels both identities and burns both deposits, a pigment stain no forgery survives, and a pulse check each epoch re-verifies the entity still exists.
